Vicodin and Its Effects
I dislocated my knee, it sucked. One of the worst experiences of my life. I had to get surgery and everything, but after the surgery I was prescribed Oxycodone (Percocet) and then eventually Hydrocodone (Vicodin). My experiences with Hydrocodone surpassed those I had with Oxy, so I will just talk about the Vicodin.
I just had my surgery last week, so I'm still popping 15 mg's every 5 hours. The effects I notice from the 7.5 mg tablets I take is this.
T00:10 - slight buzz, similar to smoking my first cigarette or the first few seconds after smoking some decent Cannabis.
T00:20 - warm feelings start to rush over my body, very happy, everything just seems perfect.
T00:30 - warm feeling become more intense and more frequent. A good way for me to describe the feeling is like an orgasm in limbs of my body and in head. Eyesight has noticeably became worse everything seems fuzzy. I'm tired, but not like nodding off, just very comfortable. The pain in my knee from the surgery has disappeared.
T01:00 - Warm feelings peak in frequency, everything is perfect.
T01:15 - I'm starting to lose the warm feelings, but they still occasionally show up.
T02:30 - High is still there, but I wish I was higher. If I stand up I become light headed and dizzy. The high mostly is composed of me feeling really detached from my surroundings now.
The high mostly is composed of me feeling really detached from my surroundings now.
T04:00  - This is usually when my pain returns, still feel groggy and detached. But I take another dose soon after.
NOTE - I have been taking pain medication for two weeks now, my tolerance is surly fairly high.
This stuff is highly addictive and I know I'm going to have a hard time getting off of it.
